French expansion of the 1993 survey (Bikya pp. 36-37). p. 18: a QEL wordlist of bikyà was recorded from the last speaker in Dec 1986; p. 48 N.B.: all QELs filled in at Furu-Awa were thrown out when ISH Yaounde was dissolved in 1991. Only tone-marked name 'bikyà'.

sources.note: Nothing. Bikya passage pp. 104-105 is sociolinguistic/lexicostatistic only (one full speaker left in 1986, Mrs Dana Agayando; 14% lexical similarity with Akum, 11% with Bishuo, 24% with Nsaa/Nooni; 'only an advanced morphological analysis would be able to show..'). No transcribed forms, no tone, stress or accent.
